# windows-rs, Okojo fork

This is a fork of [microsoft/windows-rs](https://github.com/microsoft/windows-rs) that carries
patches to the `windows-reactor` UI crate for the Okojo mail client, with the aim of proposing
them upstream. It is not a release. For the real project, go to the upstream repository.

Start with [docs/fork/readme.md](../docs/fork/readme.md):

| Page | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [Overview](../docs/fork/readme.md) | What the fork is, how the branches and tools fit together |
| [Patch catalogue](../docs/fork/patches.md) | All 45 commits, their reasons and upstream status |
| [Upstreaming plan](../docs/fork/upstreaming.md) | What to propose, in what order, and the case for each |
| [Issues found](../docs/fork/issues.md) | Defects in the library, and the fork's problems and how each was closed |

The upstream documentation index is [docs/readme.md](../docs/readme.md).
